decision.note: A qualifying candidate needs parseable untruncated outputs in every case and all-label accuracy within five points of full KV and result text. If those references score 90/90, that requires at least 86/90. This selects a confirmation candidate; it does not itself establish recovery.

framing_change: Use the preceding carrier results together with the shipment information below.

reconstruction_check.note: Full KV, result text, and the compact baseline were rerun on caches rebuilt from recorded token IDs. Compare them with the interface factorial before attributing a change to supporting context.

lead: Primary measure: all four eligibility labels. Also report final-choice accuracy, parseability, truncation, eligibility confusions, and correct choices with wrong labels. Malformed outputs stay in the denominator.
interpretation_guide: Relevant support beats both the baseline and random additions: the specified supporting context helps beyond merely increasing message size. That does not prove the added entries restore the original computation. Relevant and random additions improve similarly: more retained cache, structure, or overlap with useful content may explain the change. Relevant support helps but remains well below full KV and text: the selected-state handoff still has unresolved limitations. Supported KV remains poor while supported text works: the passages are sufficient through text, but reusing their contextual states remains unreliable. Both supported KV and supported text deteriorate: inspect conflicting instructions, sender errors, formatting, and truncation before attributing the result to KV reuse. Supported KV approaches the references: apply the existing development advancement rule. Qualification selects a confirmation candidate; it does not itself establish recovery.
timing_note: process_time_s includes recorded A generation time, cache reconstruction, gather/re-rotation, and B. Network is not measured.
after_this_run: These are development results. Do not load plan4_hold. A professor cost comparison at four and twelve carriers waits until a candidate qualifies.
